title: Apec summit live: Xi welcomes Trump on China visit as Putin claims Europe in ‘humiliating decline’
summary_full: Summit in Chinese tech hub Shenzhen set to include highly anticipated meeting between Xi, Trump and PutinShenzhen takes centre stage as Xi sends ‘Chinamaxxing’ message at Apec summitWhat is Apec? Explained in 30 secondsYalta became a byword for betrayal. Will Trump, Xi and Putin enact another carve-up?That is the question the Guardian’s diplomatic correspondent Patrick Wintour seeks to address in his piece about the expected, Putin, Trump and Xi, meeting at Apec on Thursday.It is a truism in diplomacy that if you are not around the table, the risk is that you, or your values, are on the menu and about to be carved up. Many excluded from the summit in Shenzhen, principally Ukraine but also eastern Europe and Baltic countries, Taiwan and even Iran, have reason to be nervous that their sponsors might abandon them in a complex geopolitical trade-off that Putin envisions, and Trump seems to endorse.
